描述_ZN: The Pomegranate Scroll, Modern, painted by Chen Shizeng, on paper with color, 133.2 cm long and 32 cm wide.　　Self-titled: "Gromwell '0723' accompanied by this pomegranate, the fumigant wind at first, the fire clouds not flowing, Observer the hot scenery in the vermilion summer, accounting for the bountiful year of wheat and autumn. Written on the day after Duan Yang in Xin You, Heng Ke." Inscriptions of "Shi Zeng", "The Decrepit", and "Riyi tens of millions".　　"Xin You" is the tenth year of the Republic of China (1921).　　The picture depicts autumn flowers and fruits, including pomegranates and okra. The brushwork is quite full and the strokes are dynamic. The colors are applied with light ink to ease the intensity and brightness of the colors, thus achieving an elegant color effect.
